subject: Request: half-day redline workshop & onboarding checkpoint (BlueGrove Health)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Request: half-day redline workshop & onboarding checkpoint (BlueGrove Health)

Hi Lena / BlueGrove team,

Thanks again for the productive intake call last week. We reviewed the annotated MSA you sent and — to avoid back-and-forth over email — would like to propose a focused half-day redline workshop where legal and procurement can go line-by-line with our legal team and an onboarding checkpoint with our implementation lead.

Proposed options (PST):
- Option A: Tue 2026-06-29, 9:30 AM – 1:30 PM
- Option B: Wed 2026-06-30, 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Draft agenda (3.5–4 hours):
1) Introductions & objectives (15m)
2) Headline commercial items and concessions (30m)
3) Line-by-line walk of annotated MSA (120m, breakout for highly technical clauses)
4) Onboarding checkpoint & next steps (45m)

Please confirm which option works, who from your side needs to be at the table (legal, procurement, product, IT/security), and whether you prefer we share a consolidated redline (we have attached our current annotated PDF).

Attachment: redline-annotated-MSA-v3.pdf (annotated copy for discussion)

Thanks — happy to compress if you prefer a shorter session.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Request: half-day redline workshop & onboarding checkpoint (BlueGrove Health)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together and for the annotated PDF. Option B (Wed 6/30, 12–4pm PST) looks better for our cross-functional attendees.

Attendees from BlueGrove we plan to include:
- Lena Ortiz, Procurement (me)
- Carlos Mendez, Legal (in-house counsel)
- Priya Shah, IT Security (brief presence for questions about data handling)
- Procurement mailbox (for PO/finance)

A couple quick asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm who from Redwood Legal will lead the redline discussion?
2) We typically request a vendor intake form completed and any SOC2 / security evidence in advance — can you share a short pre-read folder?

We can tentatively hold the window and will confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Procurement
BlueGrove Health

Hi Lena — really appreciate the quick reply.

Short answers: our Counsel who will lead the redline is Olga Petrov (cc'd). For pre-reads, I just shared a private drive folder with our annotated MSA, a short onboarding runbook, and SOC2 summary. Link below.

Proposed consolidated plan:
- Wed 2026-06-30, 12:00–3:30 PM PST (we trimmed to a 3.5hr focused session per Karthik's note)
- Required attendees: BlueGrove legal + procurement + IT security; Redwood legal (Olga), commercial (me & Ben), implementation (Karthik)
- We will prepare a 'decision tracker' Google Sheet during the session for quick signoffs and open items.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-redwood-bluegrove-onboard

Attachment: redline-annotated-MSA-v3.pdf (already in drive)

If that works, I will send a calendar invite with a short prep note and the decision tracker template.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all — quick operational note from the implementation side.

We recommend a tight 3.5-hour block rather than a full 4hr workshop to keep momentum and get to decisions. Suggested timing: 12:00–3:30 PM PST on Wed 6/30. We'll include a 10-minute stretch break after 90 minutes and breakout rooms for two technical items (data handling and SSO).

Also, for BlueGrove's pre-work ask: we can share a SOC2 summary and a short security FAQ by EOD tomorrow. If BlueGrove has a vendor intake spreadsheet, please send it ahead so our IT/security can pre-populate any fields.

Olga will lead legal; I will lead onboarding content and the decision tracker.

—Karthik
